title: The maximum, four threads
summary: Four threads, one slice each; the main thread combines the results.
hints: Give every thread a slice `[from, to)`: with `k` the thread number, `from = k * n / 4` and `to = (k + 1) * n / 4`. When `n` is below 4 some slices are empty.
A thread with an empty slice must not report a made-up maximum: start each thread's `max` at `INT_MIN` (`<limits.h>`) and let the main thread take the largest.
